answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the summit of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The oasis holds work receipts rather than names, so the voyage of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
